brief:
Palestinian civil society groups and political factions have criticized President Mahmoud Abbas's decision to postpone legislative elections, with observers questioning the legitimacy of governance without an elected parliament. Abbas provided no timeline for rescheduling the vote, originally planned to take place this year, according to Al Jazeera English.

The postponement reignites longstanding tensions over Palestinian representation. Abbas justified the delay by citing Israeli restrictions on voting in East Jerusalem, though critics argued the president used security concerns to avoid elections that could have weakened his political standing and that of his Fatah faction.
dek: Palestinians have reacted to President Mahmoud Abbas’ decision to postpone the Palestinian legislative elections.
title: Abbas delays Palestinian legislative elections amid public outcry
